title: GSE circular executable-geometry peak-field Teacher feasibility V1R
purpose: Repeat the unchanged V1 science after replacing inconsistent float32/float64 half-bin audit conversion with the encoder's one canonical bearing conversion.

approval.scope: One immutable system-corrected V1R C01-C08 representation audit; zero Teacher export, training, new inference, C09/C10/M-TARE, graph or planner.
approval.confirmation_reference: User explicitly delegated best-method decisions and continuous execution.

raw_sources: Sealed C01-C08 deduplicated range/valid arrays and observable exit targets.
Sealed C01-C08 incident-only exit-token audit with line-of-sight distance and opening geometry.
Circular field V1 metric-interface failure evidence.
source.license_or_allowed_use: Local project-generated procedural worlds and derived geometry/LiDAR evidence.

worlds.forbidden: C09, C10 and all M-TARE worlds

sampling.rule: Unchanged V1 population and 180-bin method; every visible exit center uses the shared canonical float64 unit-vector-to-bearing conversion.

teacher.source: TNG/spline/native-mesh derived incident exit visibility, robot-frame heading, opening width/mask and four-value vertical profile; line-of-sight distance only diagnoses rejected wide sectors.
teacher.use: No export occurs. In-memory peak fields are discarded after exact checks.
teacher.valid_mask: Visible presence is always valid and width has an independent mask; invalid width never removes a peak or profile.
teacher.student_input: No student. The raw-range envelope baseline receives only the current fifth range/valid image.
teacher.planner_consistency_plan: No graph; future edges remain execution verified.

split.checkpoint_and_threshold_selection: None; tied-threshold raw-range ranking at the existing 0.995 precision floor.
split.historical_pollution_audit: Only named C01-C08 sources, motivation evidence and V1 system failure are read.

methods.main: Unchanged 180-bin circular peak field; V1R only shares canonical unit-vector-to-angle/bin/residual conversion between encoder and evaluator.
methods.baseline: Wide opening-sector circular components and no-learning current-scan free-range envelope.
methods.fallback: Any genuine collision, non-lossless geometry, rotation/causality or hidden identity/future dependence stops Teacher export.

acceptance.population: Exact 80 worlds, 252430 frames, 188126 observations, 396913 exits and 389026/7887 width split.
acceptance.uniqueness: Zero same/adjacent-bin collisions and exact cardinalities.
acceptance.geometry: Heading/rotation residual<=1e-4 degree, width/profile exact, slot invariant.
acceptance.baseline_attribution: Reproduce 22626 sector mismatch and 22381 overlap rows; range ranking diagnostic only.
acceptance.system: All hashes match; zero export/training/new inference/graph/test worlds.

failure_policy: Any source, count, bin, geometry, rotation, reference or isolation ambiguity fails closed; V1 result remains system/metric failure.
retention: Retain summary/CSV, PNG/PDF/SVG/source, raw log, environment, RUN_STATE and seal.

estimated_cost.compute: CPU read-only full shard and 547MB streaming audit
